title: Grateful Dead Live at Stanley Theatre on 1972-09-28

ai_review.summary: A top‑notch Bertha soundboard remaster captures a high‑energy 1972 show with blistering "Other One" jams and an epic "Greatest Story" finale.
ai_review.review: The remastered SBD recording is praised as crystal‑clear, with a booming bass, immaculate Jerry Strat tone and prominent Bobby rhythm work. Musically the concert is described as powerful and captivating – highlighted by Phil’s rolling bomb solo into a scorching "Other One" and an unforgettable "Greatest Story" suite that leaves listeners “yummy with chips.”

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews give 5‑star ratings, uniformly praising both performance and audio quality; the show is deemed exceptional and the remaster excellent.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bertha remaster described as top‑notch with booming bass, immaculate guitar tone, high‑in‑mix rhythm guitars and a well‑balanced overall mix; no technical complaints.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth flow through classic numbers, building to a high‑energy "Other One" jam and culminating in an epic "Greatest Story" segment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Immaculate Strat tone with 27 tonal qualities; guitar work praised as flawless.
band_member_comments.Phil: Powerful solo into "Other One" described as a rolling bomb.
band_member_comments.Bob: Beautiful rhythm guitar, high in the mix and very real.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboard work laid down fine, supporting the band effortlessly.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill (drums) coaxing the band on, commanding the performance.
